Merit Award Financial Aid Government Scholarship Schemes MYSY State Government Merit Scholarship CM Scholarship Gujarat Government Scholarship Portal SHODH Research & Doctoral Fellowship ISEL Education Loan Interest Relief Mukhyamantri Yuva Swavalamban Yojana (MYSY) State Government Merit Scholarship The MYSY scheme is designed for economically weaker students who have performed well academically. It covers tuition fees, hostel, and other expenses for students admitted to Government and Government-aided institutions in Gujarat. Eligibility Criteria Annual family income not exceeding ₹6 lakhs Must have scored 80% or above in qualifying examination Applicable for Diploma, UG, and PG programs Available for Gujarat domicile students only Scheme Benefits Full tuition fee waiver for eligible students Hostel expenses up to ₹1,200/month Book grant and other educational expenses Renewable every academic year on maintaining performance Apply at mysy.guj.nic.in Information on Student-Oriented Schemes Implemented under KCG Office by the Education Department, Government of Gujarat Detailed information regarding the various student-oriented schemes implemented under the Knowledge Consortium of Gujarat (KCG).
